title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Issue of "When a People's Procuratorate Issues a 'Notice of Case Filing', It Shall Transfer the Relevant Materials Proving That a Case Should Be Filed to the Public Security Authority"

articles.content_en:
No. 3 [1998] of the Supreme People's Procuratorate Interpretations
Hainan Provincial People's Procuratorate:
Your Request (Qiong Jian Fa Xing Bu Zi [1998] No. 1) titled 'Request for Instructions on Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Provisions on Several Issues in the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law' has been received. Upon review, the reply is as follows:
When a People's Procuratorate issues a 'Notice to Initiate a Case' to a public security organ, it shall simultaneously transfer the materials proving that the case shall be initiated to the public security organ. The above-mentioned 'materials proving that the case shall be initiated' mainly refer to the victim's accusation materials, or materials discovered by the procuratorial organ during the review of reports, review of arrests, and review of prosecutions. During the supervision of case initiation, a People's Procuratorate shall not conduct investigation, but may carry out necessary investigation and verification of the relevant materials on which the notice to the public security organ to initiate a case is based.
Supreme People's Procuratorate
May 12, 1998
